name: warp
description: Forward Codex lifecycle events to Warp tab and system notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex running and completion status in Warp.
interface.longDescription: Forwards Codex SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, and Stop hooks to Warp's CLI agent notification pipeline so Warp can show tab badges, vertical tab status, and native notifications. Designed for patched Warp OSS builds with local, SSH, and tmux environments.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex in Warp and notify me when done.
